steps.instruction: Add a little more medium to your piles than the block-in had — this layer must be fatter than the last.
Restate each mass with its real color temperature: warm/cool shifts across a form come before any detail inside it. Sample your reference photo on both the lit and shadow side of each form.
Model form with value steps no smaller than you can actually see at arm's length — usually three to five per form. More steps now means chalky overblending.
Place the darkest accent and the lightest light deliberately, once each. Everything else must sit inside that range.
Resolve edges by kind: lost where form turns away, firm where planes meet, hard only where you want the eye to land.
